prompt_en: Create a photorealistic photograph of one unmistakably adult female orbital botanist inside a rotating greenhouse module during an orbital greenhouse pollination emergency. Use the supplied appearance reference to inspire her refined oval face, warm brown almond-shaped eyes, straight soft brows, slim nose, and softly full lips; her face is unobscured. Give her a structural hime cut: a long rear hair mass continues below the side panels; paired blunt cheek-to-jaw side panels frame the face with dense horizontal edges; a visible disconnected length step separates panels from rear hair without blending; both side panels remain readable beside one face; ordinary feathered face-framing layers do not substitute for the disconnected structure. Use an eye-level vertical medium portrait wide enough to include crown, complete hair ends, both hands, brush, and blossoms. A failed pollinator drone hangs above vanilla vines as she manually transfers bright golden pollen between open blossoms with a charged botanical brush. Amber alarm glyphs pulse, loose pollen drifts, and Earth arcs beyond the glass. Cool Earthlight and amber alarm illumination share direction across her face, hair, glass, and foliage.
negative_en: impossible perspective, inaccurate reflections, illustration look, warped walls, warped product geometry, broken window geometry, fake-looking background, 3D render look, excessive HDR, low resolution
